description: Defines the 'Response' entity class for survey responses, mapping to the 'm_survey_responses' database table. Includes properties for associated questions, text responses, values, and sequence ordering, with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Entity class representing a survey response, linked to a question, with response text, value, and sequence number.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the numerical value of the response.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the numerical value of the response.

methods.name: getSequenceNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the response.

methods.name: setSequenceNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the response.
